import pandas as pd

students = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "Diana"],
    "grade": [88, 92, 79, 95],
})

names = students["name"]
third_grade = students.iloc[2]["grade"]

print(names)
print(third_grade)

import pandas as pd
assert isinstance(names, pd.Series), 'names must be a Series'
assert third_grade == students.iloc[2]['grade'], 'third_grade must be the grade of row index 2'
